verify.title: Official Hipo addresses and accounts
verify.lead: Impersonation is common on TON. This page is the only authoritative list. If something claims to be Hipo and is not on it, it is not us.
verify.never.heading: Hipo will never
verify.never.item1: Ask you to connect your wallet to claim a reward or an airdrop
verify.never.item2: Ask you to sign a transaction you did not start yourself
verify.never.item3: Ask for your seed phrase or private key, for any reason
verify.never.item4: Send you tokens you did not expect, or ask you to send tokens to "verify" a wallet
verify.never.item5: Message you first from a team member’s personal account
verify.never.note: A message that does any of these is a scam, whatever name or picture it carries. Report it in @hipo_chat, and see phishing awareness for the longer version.
verify.wallets.heading: Wallets
verify.wallets.main: Main wallet. Where communication with users comes from.
verify.wallets.outreach: Outreach campaigns. Sends informational messages only.
verify.wallets.note1: These are the only wallets Hipo uses to contact people. What we send is informational and never asks you to do anything with your wallet.
verify.wallets.note2: Your wallet shows you the address, not the name above it — so check the address. Each wallet is listed twice because TON writes one address two ways: UQ… and EQ… are the same account, and explorers differ over which they display. Either one is correct, and neither will match a lookalike.
verify.contracts.heading: Contracts
verify.contracts.treasury: The main protocol contract: it receives deposits and holds staked GRAM.
verify.contracts.hgram: The liquid staking token you receive. This address can change on a protocol upgrade.
verify.contracts.hpo: The governance token. There is only one HPO; check before you swap.
verify.contracts.note: The same list, with the audit reports, is in Contracts & Audits.
verify.telegram.heading: Telegram
verify.telegram.teamBody: These are real team members. They will never message you first, and they never offer support in direct messages. If one of these names contacts you out of nowhere, it is an impersonator copying the name and the photo.
verify.web.heading: Website and social accounts
verify.web.site: — the only official website. The docs are at hipo.finance/docs/ and the app at hipo.finance/stake/; docs.hipo.finance redirects here.
verify.web.note: Hipo runs no other website, no token sale and no "support portal". There is no Hipo app anywhere but hipo.finance.
verify.ask.heading: Not sure about something?
verify.ask.body: Ask in @hipo_chat before you act on it. Nobody there will mind, and it takes a minute.
